question: Under what conditions must a certain teaching remain concealed in the mortal world among the lowest of men?
premises: A teaching is to be concealed with effort.
The setting specified is the mortal world.
That concealment is directed among the lowest of men.
inference: Concealment is prescribed as a measure suited to an unfit audience.
uncertainties: Scope of the teaching to be concealed remains unspecified.
plain_english: It must be concealed with effort in the mortal world, among the lowest of men.
